sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - AK-105 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Ah, it's you. Hello. I've got a job that suits you. One of my new clients needs a new weapon, but I'm currently tied up with other issues. Build me an AK-105 with a suppressor and a 60-round magazine. The requirements are: a sighting range above 800, ergonomics at or above 21, combined recoil below 500, and a weight of 4.8 kg or less. And don't forget about compactness - no more than 8 slots."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an AK-105 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Finished? Excellent. Leave it by the exit, I'll take a look later. You've already proven your skills, so I'll pay you upfront."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
AK-105 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 500 or less recoil
- 21 or more ergonomics
- 800 or greater sighting range
- 4.8 kg or less in weight
- A silencer
- AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine
Note: Despite the quest specifying a 8 slot build, 10 slots are currently accepted.

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard AK-105 from Prapor LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
